job.value: Confirm address and deal method, then place the order

arrivedFrom.value: The Buy button on a listing

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: 'Order request' with Address, Deal method and Order summary sections reads as checkout at a glance.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The full-width teal 'Place order' button at the bottom of the summary column is the strongest element on screen.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'Add address', 'Learn more' and 'Place order' each say what they do; 'Platform fee' has an info icon for its detail.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'Carousell Official Delivery' as a tag on 'Bulky item delivery' plus 'Delivered by GoGoX' layers three delivery names without saying how they relate.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: It asks only for an address and a deal method, both things the buyer knows.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: The 'By tapping on Place order, you accept…' consent paragraph and the '✓1 mover ✓Basic wrapping ✓Insurance' line are shown in full rather than tucked away.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: The 'Safer deals when you pay via Carousell' reassurance, address, deal method and payment summary all belong to checkout.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: The radio choices and totals carry it, but a multi-line legal paragraph sits directly above 'Place order'.
